changesApplied.changeMade: Added input validation: vessel_name (alphanumeric+hyphen+underscore), pod_ip (IPv4), acp_port (1-65535)
changesApplied.reason: Prevents SQL injection attacks that could delete entire vessel registry or manipulate vessel metadata
changesApplied.impactAnalysis: CRITICAL risk mitigated. Zero breaking changes - validation only rejects invalid inputs

changesApplied.changeMade: Added retry helper with exponential backoff (3 attempts, 1s initial delay). Wrapped docker exec spawn in retry logic.
changesApplied.reason: Transient container failures (restart, network issues) no longer cause permanent delegation failure. Improves reliability for distributed coordination.
changesApplied.impactAnalysis: HIGH risk mitigated. Low risk change - adds delay only on failure. Max additional latency: 7s if all retries fail.

changesApplied.changeMade: Added protocol version check (expected: 1) after ACP handshake. Logs warning for OpenCode version mismatch.
changesApplied.reason: Prevents silent failures from incompatible protocol versions. Fails fast with clear error message.
changesApplied.impactAnalysis: HIGH risk mitigated. Zero breaking changes for compatible versions. Fails fast for incompatible versions.

changesApplied.changeMade: Wrapped requestPermission in Promise.race with 30s timeout. Auto-rejects permission on timeout.
changesApplied.reason: Prevents indefinite hang if host crashes during permission request. Enables graceful degradation.
changesApplied.impactAnalysis: HIGH risk mitigated. Low risk - 30s is generous. Edge case: slow networks may timeout, but preferable to infinite hang.

changesApplied.changeMade: Added eventSubscriptions Map, isActive flag, cleanupSession() method for subscription cleanup
changesApplied.reason: Prevents memory leaks from unclosed event subscriptions in long-running processes
changesApplied.impactAnalysis: MEDIUM risk mitigated. Zero breaking changes - cleanup is opt-in. Enables proper resource management.
